note: Clark County Park District campground on 800-acre Mill Creek Lake near Marshall, a few miles off I-70: three sections of electric sites on crushed-stone pads, with a shared water spigot for every three or four sites. Boat mooring for campers off Section C, a beach, foot and horse trails; the district's ATV/OHV trails are 2.5 miles away and there is no riding in the park. Many sites are leased by the month or season. --Claude
